findings.description: get_help_record now returns `self.help` directly, which is None when no help was set, although the docstring and return type promise an empty string. The old code substituted "" for those arguments.
findings.rationale: Trigger: a command where one argument has help and another has help=None. format_positional_arguments passes (metavar, None) to formatter.write_dl, which processes the second column as text (e.g. wrap_text or len on it) and raises TypeError/AttributeError, so --help crashes.
